title: Completed repair WebView controls
summary: Added backend-owned WebView controls for selected-row Completed manifest reconciliation and sidecar metadata repair. The controls run dry-run first, require safe backend evidence and matching dry-run fingerprints, and send confirmed apply requests with confirm_apply=true while keeping all filesystem and media mutation in backend routes.
reason: Phase 4 repair/reconcile work had backend routes for Completed repairs but no operator WebView surface. Operators needed a bounded selected-row flow that could use the backend dry-run/apply contracts without introducing frontend filesystem policy or raw path mutation.
behavior_before: Completed manifest reconciliation and sidecar metadata repair routes existed in the backend contract, but the Completed WebView page did not expose selected-row dry-run/apply controls and active docs still described Completed repair controls as open.
behavior_after: The Completed page exposes a Repair/Reconcile panel for selected-row manifest reconciliation and sidecar metadata repair. Dry-run buttons send only scope, row_key, limit, and reason. Apply buttons remain disabled until backend dry-run evidence is safe for the current selection, then send dry_run_fingerprint and confirm_apply=true only. Active docs, inventories, generated summaries, and WebView/browser tests now describe and guard the implemented controls.
rollback_plan: Remove the Completed repair script include, the Completed Repair/Reconcile panel markup, and the completedView.js module wiring/exports; revert the WebView mutation-boundary and browser smoke assertions plus the docs/inventory status updates. Backend repair/reconcile routes are unchanged by this packet.
